Sandbox_ModOptionsControl_Enabled_toolti: Off: every player sets all mod options freely, all rules are ignored.
Sandbox_ModOptionsControl_DefaultPolicy_: For options without their own rule. Free (default): players may change everything until an admin locks something. Locked: everything uses the admin's values unless freed.
Sandbox_ModOptionsControl_HideLocked_too: On: locked options disappear from Options > Mods, so players only see what they may change (they can still show them greyed out on the Mod Options Control page). Off: they stay visible, greyed out and marked [Server].
Sandbox_ModOptionsControl_AdminsBypass_t: On: players who may change the sandbox are not locked, so they can set their values and copy them for everyone in the admin window. Off: admins get the same values as everyone (also in single player).
Sandbox_ModOptionsControl_KeybindsLockab: Off (recommended): key bindings in mod options always stay the player's choice.
Sandbox_ModOptionsControl_LockedList_too: Optional list separated by ; - a page ID locks all options of that mod, PageID.optionID one option. Page IDs are shown in brackets in the admin window. Rules set in the admin window win.
Sandbox_ModOptionsControl_FreeList_toolt: Like “Always locked”, for exceptions when the default rule is Locked.
